art_direction: 淡丁香底，左高右浅，视线看向右下，意外里带一点趣味。
composition_variation: Set left eye high and broad with its lid lifted; put right lower and half-lidded. Aim both pupils lower-right. Left opening is softly rounded, right elongated. The unequal forms suggest a lightly amused unexpected reveal, without sharp slants or extra features. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
